preSprayedProperties.Majority_Powder_Chemical_Composition: wt% Al <6.0%, V <4.0%, Fe <0.4%, C <0.2% and Ti balance

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: complete spallation of the cold sprayed coating layer. Crosssectional analyses revealed that the spallation occurred exactly at the coating-substrate interface and no damage was done to the substrate. On the contrary, LSP on the cold sprayed coating after heat treatment produced a compacted coating with virtually no pores

preSprayedProperties.Majority_Powder_Chemical_Composition: wt% Al <6.0%, V <4.0%, Fe <0.4%, C <0.2% and Ti balance

experimentalProperties.Deposit_Post_Treatment_Description: coupons were placed inside the furnace and heated at a slow rate of around 10 ◦C/min until the temperature reached 600◦C. We soaked the coupons at this temperature for 1 hour after which the temperature was gradually cooled down to room temperature

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: uniform coating with good metallurgical bonding at the splat interfaces as well as at the coating-substrate interface. The microstructure of the coating had recrystallized grains similar to that in heat treated condition.
